verdict.rationale: The Online Services portal holds user data such as filing and payment history, bills, and notices, so in-product AI insights is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only conventional features: viewing records, paying, responding to notices, and a deterministic penalty and interest calculator. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
